name: app-store-connect
description: Investigate Xcode Cloud failures, check App Store review readiness, and prepare releases using your App Store Connect API key.

key_id.title: App Store Connect key ID
key_id.description: Key ID of your App Store Connect Team API key.

issuer_id.title: App Store Connect issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Issuer ID belonging to the same Team API key.

private_key_path.title: Private key file
private_key_path.description: Select the matching AuthKey .p8 file. The local server reads it to sign short-lived tokens for Apple's API; the plugin does not copy or upload it.

vendor_number.title: Sales report vendor number
vendor_number.description: Optional default Apple vendor number for sales reports.

enable_writes.title: Enable write tools
enable_writes.description: Allow tools for starting builds, changing release metadata, submitting for review, and requesting analytics reports. These actions change real App Store Connect state.
